full_judgment: 6. In the trial prosecution examined 19 witnesses. Defence did not examine any witness, Defence wase a plea of innocence and further contention of the appellant Mobarak was that he had been falsely implicated in the case out of grudge and enmity. In has examination under section 342 of the Code of Criminal Procedure the appellant filed certified copies of plaint, ex parte decree and order in Title Suit No. 8 of 1971 of the 1st Court of Munsif, Brahmanbaria, for permanent injunction, which was filed by Badsha Mia, maternal grandfather of the appellant, against the father of co-accused Zillu and several others. It was also the appellant's case that he is a student of B. A. Class and was the most highly educated person in the family and this could not be tolerated by his other relations.
